snippet.title: Eagles | Hotel California | Lyrics Video
snippet.description:
Eagles | Hotel California | Lyrics Video
#Eagles #HotelCalifornia #Lyrics

[Instrumental Intro]

[Verse 1]
On a dark desert highway
Cool wind in my hair
Warm smell of colitas
Rising up through the air
Up ahead in the distance
I saw a shimmering light
My head grew heavy and my sight grew dim
I had to stop for the night

[Verse 2]
There she stood in the doorway
I heard the mission bell
And I was thinkin' to myself
"This could be Heaven or this could be Hell"
Then she lit up a candle
And she showed me the way
There were voices down the corridor
I thought I heard them say

[Chorus]
"Welcome to the Hotel California
Such a lovely place (Such a lovely place)
Such a lovely face
Plenty of room at the Hotel California
Any time of year (Any time of year)
You can find it here"

[Verse 3]
Her mind is Tiffany-twisted
She got the Mercedes Benz, uh
She got a lot of pretty, pretty boys
That she calls friends
How they dance in the courtyard
Sweet summer sweat
Some dance to remember
Some dance to forget

[Verse 4]
So I called up the Captain
"Please bring me my wine"
He said, "We haven't had that spirit here
Since 1969"
And still those voices are callin'
From far away
Wake you up in the middle of the night
Just to hear them say

[Chorus]
"Welcome to the Hotel California
Such a lovely place (Such a lovely place)
Such a lovely face
They livin' it up at the Hotel California
What a nice surprise (What a nice surprise)
Bring your alibis"

[Verse 5]
Mirrors on the ceiling
The pink champagne on ice, and she said
"We are all just prisoners here
Of our own device"
And in the master's chambers
They gathered for the feast
They stab it with their steely knives
But they just can't kill the beast

[Verse 6]
Last thing I remember, I was
Running for the door
I had to find the passage back
To the place I was before
"Relax," said the night man
"We are programmed to receive
You can check out any time you like
But you can never leave"

[Guitar Solo]

They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: Avengers Doomsday TRAILER 2 REACTION!! Doctor Doom Special Look | Sentinels
snippet.description:
AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY JUST GOT EVEN BIGGER — AND DOCTOR DOOM LOOKS ABSOLUTELY TERRIFYING!

#AvengersDoomsday #DoctorDoom #RobertDowneyJr #D23 #TrailerReaction #MarvelStudios #MCU #FantasticFour #XMen #ReelRejects 

Aaron Alexander & John Humphrey react to the brand-new Avengers: Doomsday trailer revealed at D23, featuring Robert Downey Jr. as Victor von Doom and a massive collision between the Avengers, Fantastic Four, X-Men, Wakandans, and more. Directed by Anthony & Joe Russo, Avengers: Doomsday stars Robert Downey Jr. (Iron Man, Oppenheimer) as Doctor Doom, Pedro Pascal (The Last of Us, The Mandalorian) as Reed Richards / Mister Fantastic, Vanessa Kirby (The Fantastic Four: First Steps, Mission: Impossible – Dead Reckoning) as Sue Storm, Chris Hemsworth (Thor, Extraction) as Thor, Patrick Stewart (X-Men, Star Trek: Picard) as Professor X, and Ian McKellen (The Lord of the Rings, X-Men) as Magneto.

After watching the new D23 footage, Aaron and John break down Doctor Doom’s ominous introduction, his green eyes, ceremonial armor, devastated surroundings, and the trailer’s heavy focus on his history with the Fantastic Four. They react to Reed Richards confronting Doom, the emotional hints surrounding Doom’s tragic past, Thor being blasted away with seemingly little effort, and the sheer power and presence Robert Downey Jr. brings to Marvel’s next major villain.

The conversation also explores the massive scope of Avengers: Doomsday, including appearances from Professor X, Magneto, Gambit, Wakandan heroes, Sentinels, and the larger multiversal conflict bringing multiple Marvel worlds together. Aaron and John discuss how the darker visual language surrounding Doom contrasts with the retro-futuristic world of the Fantastic Four, why the Reed and Doom relationship may provide the emotional core of the movie, and whether Doomsday could ultimately reset the MCU timeline heading into Avengers: Secret Wars.

snippet.description:
Grupo Firme
Suscríbete a Youtube: www.youtube.com/channel/UCFlC8U0Uif2hF0FIgsSIIYQ
© 2026 Music VIP Entertainment, LLC, 

Productor Ejecutivo: Isael Gutierrez
Productor Ejecutivo: Eduin Caz
Autor: Raúl Beltrán 
Director de Video Musical: Mane Borja

Instagram https://www.instagram.com/grupofirme/
Facebook https://www.facebook.com/GrupoFirmeOficial
X https://www.twitter.com/grupofirme

Letra

Qué tristeza me da saber que si no traes pasta, no te respetan
La puta sociedad se basa en lo que brilla y en lo que aparenta
Puedes ser el más falso, pero si ante las personas traes careta
Todos te creen el cuento, y si eres cagada, nadie se da cuenta
Las buenas amistades se extinguieron junto con los dinosaurios
Y si hablo de lealtad, me refiero a mí 'amá, que nunca me ha fallado
Tengo un amigo leal, que se ganó el lugar, y ahora le llamo hermano
Tal vez no es de mi sangre, pero como si lo fuera se ha portado
Hay que ser selectivo, que no todo mundo trae la misma vibra
Hay gente muy corriente, que nomás se arrima para ver que chinga
Primero piden mano y cuando se la brindas
Quieren mocharte el pie, nada más para ver después como caminas
Las vibras nunca mienten, y el sexto sentido nunca se equivoca
Hay que alejarse más de la gente que tira mierda por la boca
Al que habla por hablar, lo van a castigar, pero esa es otra cosa
Que elija cada quien el problema con el que quiera hacerse bola
Para ver quién es quién se hicieron las caídas y los malos tiempos
Porque bajo presión se hicieron los diamantes de más alto precio
Dinero hay para todos, pero es que no a todos les cae bien un peso
El poder y la fama, cuando no estás preparado, te hacen menso
Y es que a mi corta edad, les puedo asegurar, que ya he visto de todo
Ricos que se hacen pobres, y pobres bien ricos queriéndolo todo
Nadie valora nada, y quieren más billete
Yo le agradezco a Dios que con vida y salud disfruto mi presente

Avengers: Doomsday is an upcoming American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics superhero team the Avengers. Produced by Marvel Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is intended to be the sequel to Avengers: Endgame (2019) and the 39th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, and written by Michael Waldron, Stephen McFeely, and the writing team of Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers, the film features an ensemble cast led by Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom. In the film, the Avengers, Wakandans, New Avengers, Fantastic Four, and the X-Men converge from different universes to face Doom.

Two new Avengers films, The Kang Dynasty and Secret Wars, were announced in July 2022 as the conclusion of the MCU's Phase Six and "The Multiverse Saga". Jonathan Majors was set to reprise his MCU role as the villain Kang the Conqueror, with Destin Daniel Cretton and Jeff Loveness hired to direct and write The Kang Dynasty, respectively. In November 2023, Cretton departed, Waldron replaced Loveness as writer, and Marvel was considering moving away from the Kang storyline, in part due to Majors's legal issues; Majors was fired the following month. The return of the Russo brothers as directors and McFeely as co-writer, the casting of Downey as new villain Doctor Doom, and the new subtitle Doomsday were all announced in July 2024. The large cast features actors from previous MCU media and 20th Century Fox's X-Men film series, using the idea of colliding universes to bring together actors from different franchises. Filming took place from April to September 2025 at Pinewood Studios in England, with location filming in England and Bahrain.

Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled to be released in the United States on December 18, 2026, as part of Phase Six of the MCU. The sequel, Avengers: Secret Wars, is set to be released on December 17, 2027.

snippet.description:
Final trailer for RESIDENT EVIL (2026), the upcoming eighth film in Sony Pictures' Resident Evil video game horror movie franchise. This Resident Evil trailer was edited from new resident evil 8 clips and the Resident Evil 2026 trailer. Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie starring Austin Abrams, Kali Reis, Paul Walter Hauser, and Zach Cherry hits theaters September 18.

Resident Evil Trailer 2026 Breakdown:

0:00 Resident Evil Trailer Intro
0:10 Raccoon City General
0:27 From Zach Cregger
0:40 T Virus Outbreak
1:00 Zombies Attack!
1:33 Resident Evil 2026 Trailer Recap

──────────────────

A final Resident Evil trailer drop is here to remind you there's a new era of evil.

Every video game horror movie director eventually has to answer the same question: adapt the plot, or adapt the feeling? Zach Cregger, whose Resident Evil movie has spent months fielding complaints about snow and iPhones showing up in a story that the games set in a rainy late 1990s, has picked an answer, and it is the correct one for horror specifically. He is not trying to make Resident Evil 8. He is trying to adapt what it feels like to play it.

Cregger has been explicit in Comic Con press interviews about what he thinks the games actually do well: not story, but structure. He described Resident Evil's survival horror formula as one character moving location to location, each space carrying its own unique threat, with health and ammunition always running short and the world always feeling too large for the person trying to survive it. That description is not really about zombies. It is about a very specific, sustained anxiety that comes from being under-resourced in a hostile space, which is closer kin to a slasher’s stalking geography than to a typical action-horror hybrid.

The detail that sticks from his interviews is how bluntly he separates the games’ cast from his own. He said Leon and Claire “exist so perfectly in the games” that recasting them in Resident Evil trailer would only work to the detriment of what he is trying to do, and that he deliberately avoided writing one-liner banter for his lead in favor of quieter dread. 

Cregger has said his Resident Evil movie still needs the T-Virus, Umbrella Corporation, and Raccoon City itself, calling those pieces “necessary” scaffolding even while the surrounding period detail flexes. That is the tell that this is not a wholesale reinvention. It is closer to a cover version that keeps the chord progression while changing the arrangement, and horror movie franchises built on strong iconography (the Necronomicon, Michael Myers’ mask, Pinhead’s box) tend to survive exactly that kind of liberty-taking as long as the core symbols stay intact.

Whether that argument satisfies fans still bothered by the visual mismatch is a separate question from whether it is a coherent way to direct a horror movie. It is. Adapting survival horror’s feeling of being chronically under-equipped and geographically trapped is a harder, more interesting problem than matching a shooting script to a strategy guide, and it is the kind of problem a director who made Barbarian and Weapons is well suited to solve. 

Resident Evil 8 premieres September 18, and the real test will not be whether Raccoon City has snow. It will be whether the theater feels as under-resourced and cornered as the games always did.

snippet.title: I Looked Behind GTA V’s Cutscenes... It Gets Weird
snippet.description:
🔴 Catch me live on Twitch & YouTube for GTA 5/Online challenges, speedruns, chaos, commentary, news and questionable decisions • 7 PM ET • 1 AM Central Europe • 6 PM CT • Midnight UK & Ireland • 4:30 AM India • 9 AM Sydney (Oct to Apr its 1 hour earlier for Sydney daylight saving)

I’ve spent almost 15,000 hours playing GTA V, but there is an entire side of the game almost nobody is meant to see. By breaking free of the camera during GTA V’s cutscenes, we can watch what Rockstar is doing just outside our view: characters teleporting beneath the map, duplicated NPCs copying each other, weapons and objects being hidden underground, fake explosions, invisible characters, T-poses, model swaps, bizarre developer shortcuts and even apparent remnants of content that may have been changed or cut during development. From the Prologue all the way through GTA V’s endings and side missions, this is what is really happening behind the cutscenes.

snippet.title: “Special Forces” Take On an Island Full of Escaped Dinosaurs...
snippet.description:
Welcome to Clawed full gameplay! Embark on a covert mission to the dinosaur theme park Prehistoria, where you must explore the park's grounds to scavenge resources, solve puzzles, and fight your way through diverse biomes, underground tunnels and deadly enclosures. But beware, you are not the apex predator here.  ft @Fisk 

Thank you to Flatrock games for the games keys! 

Follow Me Here:
➜ http://instagram.com/thefoosterchannel 
➜ Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/thafooster

Need a Server?

If you use this link it supports me directly so thank you!

ABOUT CLAWED:
Embark on a covert mission to the dinosaur theme park Prehistoria, where you must fight to survive in this Action-Adventure Survival Horror game. Navigate diverse biomes, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the secrets hidden within the park. With danger lurking at every turn, shoot, strategize, and escape before the park becomes your grave.
Play Classic Mode or Survival Mode
Explore a fully realized dinosaur theme park with two distinct gameplay experiences:
Classic Mode: The original Clawed survival horror experience.
Survival Mode: Survive against hunger, thirst, dynamic weather, a full day/night cycle, and random dinosaur encounters as you complete your mission.
Explore Prehistoria, a rundown dinosaur park that has seen better days. Brave deadly dinosaur enclosures, delve into the underground tunnels, and aquatic environments. The entire park is yours to uncover as you make your way through this action-adventure, survival-horror.
Face off against terrifying dinosaurs, from the ruthless Deinosuchus to the swamp dwelling Spinosaurus, Prehistoria is home to many prehistoric creatures.
In traditional survival-horror fashion, your journey through the park will test your mind and wits as you work to solve challenging puzzles and difficult challenges
Fight dinos, explore the park and solve puzzles with your teammates! Invite your friends to join you on your Journey through Prehistoria.

Game Link:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3394840/Clawed/
